description: Data associated with the study: Strategic Scenario-Based Modeling for Electric Bus Charging Station Deployment in Addis Ababa is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. This repository contains the datasets and Python simulation scripts used in the study “Strategic Scenario-Based Modeling for Electric Bus Charging Station Deployment in Addis Ababa”, supporting reproducible electric bus and charging infrastructure analysis. Coverage: Ethiopia. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
